caption: Your AI plan should weight impact, not just deadlines. This five-prompt chain guides diagnosis, clarity, and weekly prioritization. Try it this week and see what climbs the list. Which task would you re-prioritize first using scoring? #AIPrompting #ProductivityTips #AIinWork #NAELBuildingBig

slides.title: Don't rank by due date
slides.body: If you only model tasks by due dates, you waste energy. Here are five prompts to plan high-impact work.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose priorities
slides.body: Task: Paste your task list here. Output: a ranked list with Task, Impact 1-5, Effort 1-5, Priority = Impact-Effort (0-10).

slides.title: 2. Improve clarity
slides.body: For each task, rewrite as a concrete deliverable and define success criteria. Output: Task, Deliverable, Acceptance criteria (1 sentence).

slides.title: 3. Plan with constraints
slides.body: Task: Use available daily hours placeholder to schedule top tasks. Output: day-by-day plan with date, hours, tasks, rationale.

slides.title: 4. Check dependencies
slides.body: Prompt: Identify task predecessors, blockers, and failure risks. Output: dependency map with Task, Predecessors, Blockers, Sequencing notes.

slides.title: 5. Refine and automate
slides.body: Prompt: Turn prior steps into a reusable weekly workflow. Output: a compact checklist and a sample prompt chain to copy.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Score tasks by impact minus effort and schedule the top items first. Save this workflow to keep planning consistent.
